paid.heading: Welcome to Crestio.
paid.subheading_logged_out: We've sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open that email to finish setting up your account.
paid.subheading_no_email: We've sent a sign-in link to your email. Open it to finish setting up your account.
paid.resend_done: Sent. Check your inbox in a minute.
paid.resend_rate_limited: Already sent recently. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
paid.resend_failed: Couldn't resend. Try again or email hello@crestio.ai.
paid.spam_hint: If it isn't there in a minute, check your spam folder.
paid.support_line: Stuck? Email hello@crestio.ai and we'll sort it out.

unpaid.heading: Your payment didn't complete.
unpaid.body: Stripe didn't return a successful payment for this checkout. If your card was charged, email hello@crestio.ai with the time you paid and we'll sort it out.

missing.heading: We can't find that checkout.
missing.body: This page needs a session id from a Crestio checkout. If you came here from an email or after paying, something dropped along the way.

error.heading: Something went wrong.
error.body: We couldn't look up your payment right now. Refresh in a moment, or email hello@crestio.ai if it keeps happening.
